props.command: A new beat sheet needs narration for two beats. No API key. No metered service. Generate the audio locally with the free Kokoro engine — and skip the fellows report beat and the intentional silence beat.
output: load Kokoro-82M ONNX model (~330MB, local, one-time)
for each speaking beat — synth mp3 with voice am_onyx, measure with ffprobe
stamp actual_duration_s + audio_file back into beat_sheet.json (atomic)

beats.role_note: EXECUTIVE-SUMMARY LAW — hesitant writer, portrait. lineSpacing 2.5 lifts 9:16 BLUF coverage.
beats.narration_text: Watch the writer walk this back. Kokoro is not paid and remote. It is a free, local ONNX model that runs on this laptop's CPU. No key. No meter. No account. Just voices.

beats.role_note: WORKED EXAMPLE — disposable fixture, portrait code card. Observed dry-run.
beats.narration_text: Worked example. Disposable fixture — one beat sheet with six beats. B zero and B one have plain narration. B two is marked as a source report — preserve the fellow's audio. B three has silent equals true. B four's narration starts with LOST in square brackets. B five's engine field is set to nbb. Run dash dash dry run against the fixture. Two beats would generate. Two source or silent skips. One sentinel skip. One engine skip. Cost: zero dollars. No mp3 written. No sheet mutated.

props.title: demo/fixture-reel  →  --dry-run
props.code:
# demo/fixture-reel/beat_sheet.json
#   6 beats:
#  B00  "First beat..."
#         → SPEAKS
#  B01  "Second beat..."
#         → SPEAKS
#  B02  kind: source_report
#         → SKIP (source)
#  B03  silent: true
#         → SKIP (silence)
#  B04  "[LOST] ..."
#         → SKIP (sentinel)
#  B05  engine: 'nbb'
#         → SKIP (non-kokoro)

$ generate_audio_kokoro.py \
    demo/fixture-reel --dry-run
[kokoro] B02 SKIPPED
  — source audio / silence
[kokoro] B03 SKIPPED
  — source audio / silence
[kokoro] B04  SKIPPED
  — narration_text is a
    sentinel, not narration
[kokoro] B05  engine=nbb
  — skipped (run its own
    generator)
[kokoro] (dry-run) B00
  voice=am_onyx  49 chars
[kokoro] (dry-run) B01
  voice=am_onyx  24 chars
[kokoro] 2 beat(s) would
  generate — cost: $0.00

beats.role_note: VERDICT — the whole surface, six lines. Portrait verdict artifact.
beats.narration_text: So — generate audio kokoro dot py. The free voice engine. One optional positional and five flags. One Kokoro ONNX model on disk — three hundred and thirty megabytes, one time, no account. One symbol table normalizes physics glyphs before synth. Five skip rules keep source reports, silences, sentinels, filtered beats and non kokoro beats out of the loop. Every survivor becomes one MP3 whose measured duration is written back into the beat sheet. Ground truth. Same interface as the paid engine — downstream never knows which engine spoke.

props.artifactHeading: generate_audio_kokoro.py — the whole surface, in order
artifactLines: input — a reel folder; voice from beat.voice or metadata.voice_kokoro.
engine — local Kokoro ONNX (~330MB, Apache-2.0, ~54 voices).
filter — skip source_reports, silence, sentinels, --only misses, non-kokoro.
synth — normalize symbols, k.create(), wav → mp3 -q:a 2 atomically.
